data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: Cursor snapshot at bridge_state/cursor-snapshot.json captures both bridge-outbound and bridge-inbound cursors and is committed to the tickets branch

Replace cursor_snapshot stub in plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/cursor_snapshot.py. Steps: 1) Resolve tickets-branch HEAD SHA via git rev-parse. 2) Read .outbound-checkpoint.json from tickets branch (git show tickets:.outbound-checkpoint.json), null if absent. 3) Read bridge_state/inbound-cursor.json, null if absent. 4) Idempotence: if cursor-snapshot.json on tickets branch already has matching head_sha, return ok=True with skipped=True, no new commit. 5) Atomic write: serialize to tempfile, fsync, os.rename. 6) Commit to tickets orphan branch via git plumbing. Cleanup tempfile in finally on failure.

## TDD Test Spec
Given tmp git repo with tickets branch containing .outbound-checkpoint.json and inbound-cursor.json; When cursor_snapshot() runs; Then cursor-snapshot.json exists on tickets branch with head_sha + both cursors + captured_at, write went through atomic rename, git log shows new commit. Second invocation with unchanged HEAD returns ok=True with skipped=True and no new commit. Invalid JSON inbound cursor returns ok=False, no snapshot written, no tmpfile remains.

## testing_mode: RED
data.title: Implement cursor_snapshot step with atomic write + tickets-branch commit + HEAD-SHA idempotence
